cues.text: It's time for the annual fee review.
Who's going to benchmark every fee?
Today that means collecting competitor schedules by hand. PDF by PDF. For weeks.
And it's stale before you present it.
With Fee Insight, it's already done.
Every fee you charge, positioned against the peers you compete with.
Percentile. Gap to median. Risk profile.
Move a price, and watch what moves with it.
Revenue, percentile and risk — before you commit.
Then let Hamilton write it up.
Board-ready, every figure traced to a competitor's published schedule.
Your annual fee review, in an afternoon.
